note: The entry follows Silvestri's 1901 original diagnosis (female alate); the original is a library OCR text of a BHL fascicle, the Latin diagnosis being short, so it can only be paraphrased from that.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (The original describes the female only.) Antennae 18-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Pronotum one third wider than long, almost heart-shaped, with a notch on the posterior margin. Body length with wings 19 mm, body length without wings 9 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original was published as Eutermes arenarius subsp. pluriarticulatus, so the original description is only a short Latin diagnosis of that subspecies; the text gives the female only. Locality Coxipó (Cuiabá), Brazil (collected by Silvestri).
